# MatDo

> MatDo is a self-hosted task manager with the features of Todoist (projects, sections, sub-tasks, labels, priorities p1–p4, due dates, repeating tasks, deadlines, comments) plus teams that share projects. Tasks are typed in natural language (German and English) and can be created by a webhook, for example from an Apple Shortcut that dictates the text.

The user interface is German. Everything except the start page needs an account. The only public API is the webhook below; it needs the secret token of a webhook that a signed-in person creates under Einstellungen → Webhooks.

## Webhook: create a task

- `POST /api/v1/webhook/{token}` with JSON `{"text": "...", "description": "..."}`, a form (`text=...`) or plain text. Alternatively `POST /api/v1/webhook` with the header `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.
- Answer `201` with JSON: `id`, `content`, `description`, `project`, `due` (yyyy-MM-dd), `time` (HH:mm), `dueText`, `recurrence`, `deadline`, `priority` (1 highest … 4 none), `labels`, `url`, `message` (one sentence for a notification).
- `400` when the text has no title, `404` for an unknown or switched-off token, `429` after 60 calls a minute.

## How the text is read

- Dates: heute, morgen, übermorgen, am Freitag, nächsten Montag, in 3 Tagen, nächste Woche, am Wochenende, Monatsende, 24.12., 24.12.2026, 24. Dezember, 2026-12-24; English: today, tomorrow, next friday, in 5 days, Dec 24.
- Times: um 15 Uhr, 15:30, 9.30 Uhr, um halb 4, um 7 abends, morgen früh, heute Abend, 3pm.
- Repeating: täglich, jeden Tag, werktags, jeden Montag, jede Woche, alle 2 Wochen, jeden Monat, jeden 15., jährlich; every day, every monday.
- `#Projekt` (also names with spaces), `@label`, `p1`–`p4`, `/Abschnitt`, `{Freitag}` = deadline.
- Keywords of the person (default: „Projekt EIMER“, „Label Einkauf“, „Priorität 1“, „Abschnitt Planung“, „Frist Freitag“, „Beschreibung …“ = the rest becomes the description). Each person can change them under Einstellungen → Schlüsselwörter.
- Example: „Projekt EIMER Angebot schreiben übermorgen um 9 Uhr Priorität 1“ → task „Angebot schreiben“ in project EIMER, due the day after tomorrow at 09:00, priority 1.
